questions.question: What was the program-wide savings rate (total savings over total benchmark) in each performance year from 2013 to 2024?
questions.metricflow_sql:
SELECT
  metric_time__year
  , CAST(total_savings AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(total_benchmark, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS savings_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('year', performance_year_start) AS metric_time__year
    , SUM(benchmark_minus_expenditures) AS total_savings
    , SUM(total_benchmark_expenditures) AS total_benchmark
  FROM "aco"."core"."fct_aco_financial_year" aco_performance_periods_src_10000
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('year', performance_year_start)
) subq_5

questions.question: In PY 2024, how much did CMS pay ACOs in shared savings, how much did ACOs owe in losses, and what were net savings to Medicare?
questions.metricflow_sql:
SELECT
    performance_year AS aco_period__performance_year
    , benchmark_minus_expenditures AS __total_savings
    , earned_shared_savings AS __earned_shared_savings
    , shared_losses_owed AS __shared_losses_owed
  FROM "aco"."core"."fct_aco_financial_year" aco_performance_periods_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_6.earned_shared_savings) AS earned_shared_savings
  , MAX(subq_6.shared_losses_owed) AS shared_losses_owed
  , MAX(subq_13.net_savings_to_medicare) AS net_savings_to_medicare
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(earned_shared_savings) AS earned_shared_savings
    , SUM(shared_losses_owed) AS shared_losses_owed
  FROM (
    SELECT
      aco_period__performance_year
      , __earned_shared_savings AS earned_shared_savings
      , __shared_losses_owed AS shared_losses_owed
    FROM sma_10002_cte
  ) subq_2
  WHERE aco_period__performance_year = 2024
) subq_6
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    total_savings - earned_shared_savings + shared_losses_owed AS net_savings_to_medicare
  FROM (
    SELECT
      SUM(total_savings) AS total_savings
      , SUM(earned_shared_savings) AS earned_shared_savings
      , SUM(shared_losses_owed) AS shared_losses_owed
    FROM (
      SELECT
        aco_period__performance_year
        , __total_savings AS total_savings
        , __earned_shared_savings AS earned_shared_savings
        , __shared_losses_owed AS shared_losses_owed
      FROM sma_10002_cte
    ) subq_8
    WHERE aco_period__performance_year = 2024
  ) subq_12
) subq_13
questions.independent_sql: select sum(greatest(e, 0)) as earned_shared_savings, sum(greatest(-e, 0)) as shared_losses_owed, sum(bme) - sum(greatest(e, 0)) + sum(greatest(-e, 0)) as net_savings_to_medicare from (select try_cast(nullif(replace(replace(replace(trim("EarnSaveLoss"), '$', ''), ',', ''), '%', ''), '') as double) as e, try_cast(nullif(replace(replace(replace(trim("BnchmkMinExp"), '$', ''), ',', ''), '%', ''), '') as double) as bme from raw.puf_py2024)

questions.question: Which track family had the highest savings rate in PY 2024?
questions.metricflow_sql:
SELECT
  track__track_family
  , CAST(total_savings AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(total_benchmark, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS savings_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    track__track_family
    , SUM(total_savings) AS total_savings
    , SUM(total_benchmark) AS total_benchmark
  FROM (
    SELECT
      aco_performance_periods_src_10000.performance_year AS aco_period__performance_year
      , tracks_src_10000.track_family AS track__track_family
      , aco_performance_periods_src_10000.total_benchmark_expenditures AS total_benchmark
      , aco_performance_periods_src_10000.benchmark_minus_expenditures AS total_savings
    FROM "aco"."core"."fct_aco_financial_year" aco_performance_periods_src_10000
    LEFT OUTER JOIN
      "aco"."core"."dim_track" tracks_src_10000
    ON
      aco_performance_periods_src_10000.track_code = tracks_src_10000.track_code
  ) subq_5
  WHERE aco_period__performance_year = 2024
  GROUP BY
    track__track_family
) subq_9
questions.independent_sql: select case trim("Current_Track") when 'A' then 'BASIC A and B (one-sided)' when 'B' then 'BASIC A and B (one-sided)' when 'C' then 'BASIC C to E (two-sided)' when 'D' then 'BASIC C to E (two-sided)' when 'E' then 'BASIC C to E (two-sided)' when 'EN' then 'ENHANCED' end as track_family, sum(try_cast(nullif(replace(replace(replace(trim("BnchmkMinExp"), '$', ''), ',', ''), '%', ''), '') as double)) / sum(try_cast(nullif(replace(replace(replace(trim("ABtotBnchmk"), '$', ''), ',', ''), '%', ''), '') as double)) as savings_rate from raw.puf_py2024 group by 1

) subq_2

questions.question: What share of ACO reconciliations earned a shared savings payment in each year from 2021 to 2024?
questions.metricflow_sql:
SELECT
  metric_time__year
  , CAST(reconciliations_earning_savings_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(reconciliations_count, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS share_earning_savings
FROM (
  SELECT
    metric_time__year
    , SUM(reconciliations_earning_savings_count) AS reconciliations_earning_savings_count
    , SUM(reconciliations_count) AS reconciliations_count
  FROM (
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC('year', performance_year_start) AS metric_time__year
      , performance_year AS aco_period__performance_year
      , aco_period_count AS reconciliations_count
      , case when earned_shared_savings > 0 then 1 else 0 end AS reconciliations_earning_savings_count
    FROM "aco"."core"."fct_aco_financial_year" aco_performance_periods_src_10000
  ) subq_2
  WHERE aco_period__performance_year >= 2021
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__year
) subq_6

questions.question: In PY 2023, how did earned shared savings per assigned beneficiary compare between one-sided and two-sided ACOs?
questions.metricflow_sql:
SELECT
  aco_period__risk_model
  , CAST(earned_shared_savings AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(assigned_beneficiaries, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS earned_shared_savings_per_assigned_beneficiary
FROM (
  SELECT
    aco_period__risk_model
    , SUM(earned_shared_savings) AS earned_shared_savings
    , SUM(assigned_beneficiaries) AS assigned_beneficiaries
  FROM (
    SELECT
      performance_year AS aco_period__performance_year
      , risk_model AS aco_period__risk_model
      , earned_shared_savings
      , n_assigned_beneficiaries AS assigned_beneficiaries
    FROM "aco"."core"."fct_aco_financial_year" aco_performance_periods_src_10000
  ) subq_2
  WHERE aco_period__performance_year = 2023
  GROUP BY
    aco_period__risk_model
) subq_6

questions.question: What was the mean ACO quality score in each year of the APM Performance Pathway era (2021 to 2024)?
questions.metricflow_sql:
SELECT
  metric_time__year
  , AVG(mean_quality_score) AS mean_quality_score
FROM (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('year', performance_year_start) AS metric_time__year
    , performance_year AS aco_period__performance_year
    , quality_score AS mean_quality_score
  FROM "aco"."core"."fct_aco_financial_year" aco_performance_periods_src_10000
) subq_2
WHERE aco_period__performance_year >= 2021
GROUP BY
  metric_time__year

questions.question: What was risk-adjusted per capita expenditure (spending divided by CMS-HCC risk score, by enrollment type) in PY 2023 and PY 2024?
questions.metricflow_sql:
SELECT
  metric_time__year
  , CAST(risk_adjusted_expenditure AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(person_years, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS risk_adjusted_per_capita_expenditure
FROM (
  SELECT
    metric_time__year
    , SUM(risk_adjusted_expenditure) AS risk_adjusted_expenditure
    , SUM(person_years) AS person_years
  FROM (
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC('year', performance_year_start) AS metric_time__year
      , performance_year AS aco_period__performance_year
      , person_years
      , risk_adjusted_annualized_expenditure AS risk_adjusted_expenditure
    FROM "aco"."core"."fct_aco_financial_year" aco_performance_periods_src_10000
  ) subq_2
  WHERE aco_period__performance_year in (2023, 2024)
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__year
) subq_6

  , CAST(risk_weighted_person_years_sum AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(person_years_with_risk_score_sum, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS mean_risk_score
FROM (
  SELECT
    attribution_row__enrollment_type_code
    , SUM(risk_weighted_person_years_sum) AS risk_weighted_person_years_sum
    , SUM(person_years_with_risk_score_sum) AS person_years_with_risk_score_sum
  FROM (
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC('year', performance_year_start) AS metric_time__year
      , enrollment_type_code AS attribution_row__enrollment_type_code
      , risk_score * person_years AS risk_weighted_person_years_sum
      , case when risk_score is not null then person_years end AS person_years_with_risk_score_sum
    FROM "aco"."core"."fct_attribution" aco_attribution_src_10000
  ) subq_2
  WHERE metric_time__year = '2024-01-01'
  GROUP BY
    attribution_row__enrollment_type_code
) subq_6

questions.question: For Controlling High Blood Pressure (Quality ID 236) in PY 2024, what share of ACOs reported a result through each collection type?
questions.metricflow_query: query --metrics quality_reporting_rate --group-by measure_result__collection_type --where "{{ Entity('quality_measure') }} = 'Q236' and {{ TimeDimension('metric_time', 'year') }} = '2024-01-01'"
questions.metricflow_sql:
SELECT
  measure_result__collection_type
  , CAST(measure_results_reported_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(measure_results_count, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS quality_reporting_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    measure_result__collection_type
    , SUM(measure_results_reported_count) AS measure_results_reported_count
    , SUM(measure_results_count) AS measure_results_count
  FROM (
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC('year', performance_year_start) AS metric_time__year
      , measure_key AS quality_measure
      , collection_type AS measure_result__collection_type
      , 1 AS measure_results_count
      , case when is_reported then 1 else 0 end AS measure_results_reported_count
    FROM "aco"."core"."fct_aco_quality_measure" aco_quality_results_src_10000
  ) subq_2
  WHERE quality_measure = 'Q236' and metric_time__year = '2024-01-01'
  GROUP BY
    measure_result__collection_type
) subq_6

questions.question: How many ACOs saved 5 percent or more of their benchmark in PY 2024, and what was their combined savings rate?
questions.metricflow_query: query --metrics aco_count,savings_rate --where "{{ Dimension('aco_period__performance_year') }} = 2024 and {{ Dimension('aco_period__savings_rate_band') }} = '5 percent or more'"
questions.metricflow_sql:
SELECT
    performance_year AS aco_period__performance_year
    , savings_rate_band AS aco_period__savings_rate_band
    , total_benchmark_expenditures AS __total_benchmark
    , benchmark_minus_expenditures AS __total_savings
    , aco_key AS __aco_count
  FROM "aco"."core"."fct_aco_financial_year" aco_performance_periods_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_6.aco_count) AS aco_count
  , MAX(subq_13.savings_rate) AS savings_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT aco_count) AS aco_count
  FROM (
    SELECT
      aco_period__performance_year
      , aco_period__savings_rate_band
      , __aco_count AS aco_count
    FROM sma_10002_cte
  ) subq_2
  WHERE aco_period__performance_year = 2024 and aco_period__savings_rate_band = '5 percent or more'
) subq_6
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    CAST(SUM(total_savings) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(total_benchmark), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS savings_rate
  FROM (
    SELECT
      aco_period__performance_year
      , aco_period__savings_rate_band
      , __total_benchmark AS total_benchmark
      , __total_savings AS total_savings
    FROM sma_10002_cte
  ) subq_8
  WHERE aco_period__performance_year = 2024 and aco_period__savings_rate_band = '5 percent or more'
) subq_13
questions.independent_sql: select count(*) as aco_count, sum(bme) / sum(bench) as savings_rate from (select try_cast(nullif(replace(replace(replace(trim("BnchmkMinExp"), '$', ''), ',', ''), '%', ''), '') as double) as bme, try_cast(nullif(replace(replace(replace(trim("ABtotBnchmk"), '$', ''), ',', ''), '%', ''), '') as double) as bench from raw.puf_py2024) where bme / bench >= 0.05
